# Module Title

Introduction to Linux

# Authors

This tutorial was written by Jacqui Keane.

# Duration

3.5 hours

# Key topics

# Learning outcomes

-   Understand what a computer operating system is.

-   Understand the structure of Linux file system.

-   Use basic Linux commands to navigate the file system and examine data.

# Activities

-   Lecture: 30 minutes

-   Practical exercises: 2.5 hours
